content: Post-compression session cleanup follows a standard workflow: after the final compressed handoff session is successfully created and verified to exist in the WebUI session list, both the original source session and any intermediate handoff sessions should be deleted via the `/api/session/delete` endpoint to avoid stale session clutter. Valid compressed sessions are identifiable by their `[已压缩 <YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS>]` title prefix in the WebUI list.
